made_by.method: One model read each published business beside the site's readings of the value chain and each future the outlook's grid fills, gave the business a call with one line of reasoning and the one thing that would undo it, and said in words what each future does to it. A future it left out changes nothing. The same model then said, for each part of the map in scope, what is scarce there, how short it is now, in the transition and at the mature state, and which futures tighten or ease it, each with a reason. The second group of futures are each a model's summary of what named writers on the outlook argue, and were judged the same way. It also tied each of the site's migration predictions to parts of the map and to businesses, and said which of five durable things each business builds.
